slides.title: Your 1-page funnel is a *store* now.
slides.body: A new HighLevel feature, who pays for it, and the 3-click setup.

slides.title: One funnel. *One page.*
slides.body: A normal HighLevel funnel. No way to take money for products.

slides.title: Add any *store* element
slides.body: In the builder: Quick Add → Store → drop in a cart icon.

slides.title: Pick what *carries over*
slides.body: HighLevel asks which sections, popups and fonts to reuse on every store page.

slides.title: Click *Import.*
slides.body: Therefore the funnel builds the store pages for you, in the same design.

slides.title: They have a funnel. *But no way to sell.*
“I’ll turn your funnel into a *store* this week.”
bullets: Setup: store live, products loaded, checkout tested
Monthly: new products, promos, abandoned-cart follow-ups

slides.title: Comment *STORE*
slides.body: Don't sell all of HighLevel. Sell one feature.
